subject.description: FPV chase through dense night traffic on an elevated highway and truss bridge (CJK road text). Hero car ambiguous in frames: a black muscle car with twin stripes (manifest: Dodge Challenger); BMW G82 M4 and an E3x widebody also feature. Opens on untextured viewport.

shots.notes: Frames 1-2: grey viewport render, camera threads between moving cars, heavy motion blur. Low-threshold pass also fires at 0.75/1.49/1.95 s: could be cuts or FPV blur.
Frames 3-6: final night render; rear chase, under bridge trusses, squeezing past a van mirror, rising to show traffic. 0.12 threshold suggests cuts near 8.05/10.25/12.2/15.35/17.43; unproven.
